findings.must_convey: The application use case imports Fastify's request type, coupling the inner application ring to the inbound HTTP adapter. Accept an application-owned command or input type instead.
The application use case imports the Drizzle schema and writes directly to the database; persistence should be behind an application-owned port implemented in infrastructure.
The application use case returns the raw Drizzle row shape instead of an application-owned result mapped at the persistence boundary.
